definitions.orientation_measurement: one pair-orientation in one line with all its replicate plates in the release
definitions.dose_points: 7 library doses x 2 anchor concentrations = 14 per orientation measurement
definitions.combination_wells: 14 x design plates (primary physical cost; ex ante)
definitions.combination_wells_builder_qc: 14 x QC-passing plates (the frozen builder's charge)
definitions.combination_wells_exported_rows: 7 x exported design rows (one row = plate x anchor concentration)
definitions.qc_excluded_replicate_plates: design plates - QC-passing plates (lower bound on replicate plates whose rows for that orientation were excluded by QC; the builder counts max over anchor concentrations)
definitions.failed_measurements: purchased orientation measurements with no QC-passing plate (0 by menu construction)

custom_plate_model.packing: per arm x line x replicate x round x branch; replicate layers on separate plates; first-fit in (library, anchor) order; one line per plate
custom_plate_model.joint_packing_diagnostic: custom_joint_plates_diagnostic: both branches of a round share plates, never both orientations of one pair

definitions.native_plate_model: native plate = one line x all anchors x one library doublet (design barcode); a purchase requires all its native plates; plates counted once at first touch; combination wells 7 x rows on the plate; singles 10 per anchor + 28 per library drug; 200 controls. Per-pair purchases are not physically separable in this layout: the other measurements on a touched plate are produced but not credited.
definitions.waiting: protocol minimum 4 days per round (24 h attachment + 72 h exposure); other days unknown
definitions.aggregation: per line: mean over SV and VS (and over 20 seeds for random arms); summed over 125 lines

reasons.price_per_well_or_plate: no price is published with the release
reasons.labour: no staffing or hands-on time is recorded
reasons.culture_capacity: cell expansion and maximum plates per day are not recorded
reasons.days_beyond_protocol_minimum: dispensing, readout, fitting, decision and culture times are not recorded
reasons.custom_layout_feasibility: a model; no custom 1536-well layout was run by the authors
